reader.requirement: A USE statement performs no action where it stands: the declarative section it heads is not entered by normal control flow (execution starts at the first nondeclarative procedure and never falls into the declaratives), and its paragraphs run only when the stated I-O condition arises for the named file or open mode, or when PERFORMed (VIII.4.8.4 GR3); a PERFORM of the section runs its paragraphs and nothing for the USE itself.
reader.edition-search: Read CollectParagraphs (declaratives collected first, _entryPc set after them), DeclCollectSection, DeclBindUse and EmitDispatcher (__Dispatch(EntryPc, topExit)); grepped ProcedureTableBuilder.cs and DispatchEmitter.cs for Edition.Edition|Year|CobolVersion|Constructs.: nothing on the USE AFTER EXCEPTION path. The only 1985-specific branches nearby are source-driven (USE FOR DEBUGGING arm, DebugActive), not edition comparisons; the 1985 SR1 sentence-before-paragraph refusal (COBOL0900) is VersionConformancePass's and belongs to SR1.
